summary: Marginal boating day. Winds 5 kt, moderate chop on the bay. Scattered showers and storms build through the afternoon and evening and can spike local seas and gusts. Rain around 82%. Run the pass and any Gulf legs before early afternoon.
gulf_seas: 1 foot or less, then around 2 feet this afternoon
source: NWS Tampa Bay, Coastal Waters Forecast (CWFTBW)
